$comment: Phase 6 branch 4 (D6): the wake-word and VAD models, self-hosted under /voice-models/ and pinned by sha256. `make voice-models` downloads `source` (or copies the owner-trained keyword model from VOICE_WAKE_MODEL_SRC), verifies `sha256` and writes public/voice-models/<file>. The browser refuses to arm wake mode unless every file's sha256 matches. Swapping or retraining the wake phrase is a change to this file only. An empty sha256 means 'not pinned yet' and always refuses to arm.
